name: kimi
description: Check Kimi readiness and review verified frozen diffs from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare Kimi and review frozen diffs.
interface.longDescription: Verify local Kimi readiness and run foreground adversarial reviews against a frozen saved diff whose SHA-256 is verified before Kimi starts. Task delegation, background job control, rescue, and hooks are not yet included.
defaultPrompt: Use Kimi Setup to check readiness or Kimi Review to review a verified frozen diff.
